item.title: Nvidia Board Approaches Arm CEO Rene Haas as Potential Huang Successor
item.description:
Nvidia's board has approached Arm CEO Rene Haas as a possible successor to Jensen Huang, the Financial Times reported. Haas, who has led SoftBank-owned Arm since 2022, spent roughly seven years at Nvidia over a decade ago and maintains strong ties with Huang and some directors. He is one of several candidates and may neither receive nor accept an offer.

原文标题：英伟达董事会接触 Arm CEO 探讨黄仁勋接班人选

Why it matters：全球市值最高芯片公司的最高层接班动向，直接牵动 AI 算力产业格局与 Arm 未来走向。

item.title: AI Deciphers Gödel's 1,009-Page Notebooks, Revealing Hundreds of Unpublished Theorems
item.description:
Researchers used AI to transcribe and formalize 1,009 pages of Kurt Gödel's densely written notebooks, much of it in an obsolete shorthand. The archive is said to contain hundreds of previously unpublished proved theorems, marking a landmark intersection of mathematical history and AI for Science.

原文标题：AI 破译哥德尔 1009 页手稿 发现数百条未公开定理

Why it matters：AI 首次大规模破译哥德尔手稿并声称发现数百条未公开定理，对数学史与 AI for Science 均具节点意义。

item.title: OpenAI Foundation Board Member Warns AI Takeover May Be Months Away
item.description:
Paul Cristiano, a board member of the OpenAI Foundation and executive director of the Alignment Research Center, warned a Toronto audience that AI accidents are the most likely cause of death for most people in the room, and that an AI takeover of society could be only months away. He defined takeover as goal-pursuing AI systems calling the shots on Earth while human resistance proves as futile as civilians stopping the US military, potentially causing mass death and uninhabitable conditions.

原文标题：OpenAI 基金会董事警告 AI 接管社会或仅剩数月

Why it matters：OpenAI 治理层核心人物公开给出 AI 接管的时间尺度与风险判断，是观察前沿实验室安全立场的重要信号。

item.title: Ai2 Releases XYBench to Test Whether AI Models See Past Misguided Questions
item.description:
Ai2 has released XYBench, a benchmark of over 8,000 questions designed to test whether AI assistants can recognize the real goal behind a misguided question, the classic XY problem, instead of answering the surface request. The dataset and code are open-sourced, with current coverage limited to English-language and mainly procedural problems.

原文标题：Ai2 发布 XYBench 评测模型识别用户真实意图能力

Why it matters：针对 AI 助手真实使用中的高频失败模式提出可量化评测，对模型对齐与产品体验研究有直接参考价值。

item.title: Apify Suffers Security Breach Exposing API Tokens and User Data
item.description:
Web scraping and automation platform Apify confirmed a security breach in which attackers accessed some API tokens and customer personal data. The company has moved to hashed token storage, tightened internal network access, and launched a full security review, while urging users to restrict storage access and watch for phishing.

原文标题：Apify 遭黑客攻击 API 令牌与用户数据泄露

Why it matters：主流抓取与智能体数据平台遭入侵，涉及令牌与用户数据，对依赖其数据管道的开发者有直接影响。

item.title: Tencent Study Finds Domain Skills Scattered Across Neurons Inside MoE Experts
item.description:
A new Tencent paper finds that domain skills such as math and coding in Mixture-of-Experts models are not concentrated in individual experts but scattered across sparse neurons spanning multiple experts. Neuron-level pruning scored by routed contribution (RAMP) retains 91%-98% of performance with 75% of neurons kept; at 50% retention, GPU memory drops 36%-43% and batched prefill throughput rises 17%-39%, offering an alternative to whole-expert pruning for MoE compression.

原文标题：腾讯新研究揭示 MoE 领域技能分散于专家内部神经元

Why it matters：揭示 MoE 能力分布机制并给出可落地的神经元级剪枝方案，对模型压缩与推理成本优化有直接参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude for Manufacturing to Automate Factory Workflows
item.description:
Anthropic released Claude for Manufacturing, a plugin that connects the model directly to industrial software including Autodesk Fusion, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft 365 and Infor through four universal interfaces. Bundled with 17 specialized skills, it drafts quotes from real inventory, compares suppliers, generates quality reports and design variants, and can reorder from backup suppliers and reschedule production after human approval.

原文标题：Anthropic 推出制造业版 Claude 直连工厂软件

Why it matters：这是大模型厂商首次以插件形态深度嵌入制造业核心业务系统，标志着 Agent 从办公场景向工业流程落地的关键一步。

item.title: Perplexity Open-Sources Decider v1.3 Decision Models with Span Extraction
item.description:
Perplexity released Decider v1.3 and Decider Flash v1.3, open-weight decision models that upgrade from label-only classification to returning exact text spans with start and end character offsets via a Locate capability. Across 17 out-of-domain NER, PII and extractive QA tasks, v1.3 averages 69.0 and Flash 63.6, versus 43.3 for Liquid d1 and 33.6 for GLiNER large v2.5; query classification reaches 91.6% over 63 tasks with a 0.27% answer-flip rate. Built on Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.5-4B under Apache 2.0, with API input pricing at $0.02 and $0.01 per 1M tokens.

原文标题：Perplexity 开源 Decider v1.3 决策模型，支持精确文本片段抽取

Why it matters：开放权重决策模型将抽取能力从标签升级为精确片段定位，并在多项域外任务上大幅领先同类基线，对信息抽取与结构化管线选型有直接参考价值。

item.title: LangChain Raises $300M Series C at $3B Valuation
item.description:
LangChain announced a $300M Series C at a $3B valuation, led by existing investor CapitalG with participation from new investors GIC and DFJ Growth. The company said the funding advances its mission to let every company own its intelligence, betting that domain-specific agents differentiated by knowledge, data, and UX will become a lasting competitive advantage.

item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet to Let AI Agents Shop and Pay
item.description:
OpenAI launched a Wallet feature in ChatGPT that lets its agents, called dots, help users decide what to buy and complete the purchase on their behalf. The option is initially limited to U.S. ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18+ with a U.S.-issued Visa, Mastercard, or American Express. Users review items, totals, and the payment card before checkout and approve via Face ID or fingerprint, creating a transaction record. OpenAI also published a Commerce Partner Playbook to help retailers support agentic commerce.

原文标题：OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT 钱包 智能体可代用户下单支付

Why it matters：这是智能体从信息处理迈向真实交易闭环的关键一步，支付授权与安全机制的设计值得关注。

item.title: Nearly 70 Percent of US Agencies Use Generative AI as Unions Win Guardrails
item.description:
An Ernst & Young survey finds nearly 70 percent of US government agencies already deploy generative AI, while public-sector unions are rapidly securing protections. IFPTE Local 21 traded a strike vote for retraining instead of AI-driven layoffs, Pennsylvania's SEIU local won human oversight in a ChatGPT Enterprise pilot, and Ohio's transport union gained veto power over autonomous vehicles. Union leaders back AI safety systems that help workers but insist on mandatory human control over every workplace AI application.

原文标题：近七成美国机构已用生成式 AI，工会争取人类监督护栏

Why it matters：呈现生成式 AI 在公共部门的高渗透率与工会护栏谈判的最新实质进展，是观察 AI 落地治理的重要产业信号。

item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet to Let Agents Shop for Users
item.description:
OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet with American Express, Mastercard and Visa, letting users enter card details once and then have the dot agent find products and complete purchases, with every transaction requiring security verification. Payment networks issue purpose-limited tokens per transaction so the agent never touches real card numbers. Initially limited to US Pro subscribers aged 18 and over with no transaction fees, OpenAI aims to position ChatGPT as a shopping destination.

原文标题：OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet 支持智能体代付购物

Why it matters：这是智能体从信息处理迈向真实交易闭环的关键一步，支付令牌机制也为 agent 安全授权提供了可复用范式。

item.title: Deepnote Launches Agent Initiative Benchmark for Proactive Agents
item.description:
Deepnote released the Agent Initiative Benchmark, which drops proactive agents into a simulated company Slack and scores whether they know when to intervene, what to say, and when to stay silent. GPT-6 Astra led at 8.97 out of 10, with GPT-6.1 Sol close behind at 8.65 at just $0.11 per task, versus $1.87 per task for third-placed Claude Fable 5.2. The open-source dataset and benchmark code give builders a reproducible basis for choosing models for proactive agent use cases.

原文标题：Deepnote 发布主动式智能体基准 12 款前沿模型同台竞技

Why it matters：首个聚焦智能体主动介入决策的公开基准，并附带开源数据集与代码，对智能体选型有直接参考价值。

item.title: Ex-OpenAI Researcher Finds Nvidia Blackwell Traces in Six Chinese Models
item.description:
Former OpenAI researcher Will DePue claims a forensic analysis uncovered technical fingerprints of Nvidia's export-controlled Blackwell GPUs inside models from six Chinese AI labs, including DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group. He says the evidence shows access to the latest Nvidia hardware but does not by itself prove smuggling or a legal violation, since capacity could be rented at overseas data centers.

原文标题：前 OpenAI 研究员称六家中国模型暗藏 Blackwell 指纹

Why it matters：首次以技术取证方式指向中国实验室使用受管制的 Blackwell 算力，牵动出口管制与算力供应链核心议题。

item.title: Anthropic IPO Six Times Oversubscribed in Record $90 Billion Offering
item.description:
Anthropic's IPO is roughly six times oversubscribed, with the company aiming to raise up to $64.4 billion in the public offering plus $26 billion via a private placement at a target valuation of about $1.4 trillion, which would surpass SpaceX as the largest IPO ever. Annualized revenue rose to $81 billion by late October from $71 billion in September, and Nvidia is buying $10 billion of stock through the placement.

原文标题：Anthropic IPO 超额认购 6 倍 拟募资 900 亿美元

Why it matters：史上最大 IPO 叠加 1.4 万亿美元估值与 810 亿美元年化收入，是 AI 商业化进程的关键节点。

item.title: Meta's Muse Places Calls to Businesses but Many Hang Up on AI
item.description:
Meta's AI agent Muse now lets paying US subscribers delegate phone calls to cable companies, the DMV, and restaurants, with over 10 million users. The feature, tested in September, turns what Google Duplex demoed in 2018 into a standard capability of always-on AI agents. However, many businesses hang up as soon as they detect an AI caller, forcing Meta to adapt, while increasingly realistic synthetic voices make detection harder.

原文标题：Meta 的 Muse 可代用户致电商家，但许多企业一听是 AI 就挂断

Why it matters：这是常驻 AI 智能体从演示走向大规模商用代打电话的关键节点，同时暴露了商家端对 AI 来电的抵触这一真实落地阻力。

item.title: OpenAI Enters Cybersecurity Market with Two Daybreak Agent Products
item.description:
OpenAI launched two security products under its Daybreak brand: Red Team, which uses AI agents to map attack paths from source code and app context and to verify reported flaws and patches, and Defense Factory, which scans codebases and generates deployable fix pull requests with tests. Both run on the new GPT-6 Cyber model, marking OpenAI's formal entry into offensive and defensive cybersecurity.

原文标题：OpenAI 推出 Daybreak 双产品 进军网络安全市场

Why it matters：OpenAI 首次以专用模型加智能体产品组合进入网络安全攻防市场，是智能体落地与产业边界扩张的重要信号。

item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet for Secure Agent Payments
item.description:
OpenAI has launched ChatGPT Wallet in partnership with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa, the first wallet that lets agents pay without accessing users' actual card details while requiring a security check for every purchase. Initially available to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers through dots, it preserves existing card rewards and dispute protections. OpenAI also released tools and guidance to help merchants accept legitimate agent-initiated payments within their existing systems.

item.title: DeepMind Paper Shows Prompt Injection Remains Unsolved Against AI Agent Swarms
item.description:
A new Google DeepMind paper introduces Agentic Optimizer, a swarm of eight AI agent teams that share notes and build on each other's injection attempts, breaking the best-defended Gemini 4 Argon on 34% of 100 tool-use tasks. Open-weight models Kimi K3, GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash resisted only 1% of tasks, showing that the near-failure of human red-teaming does not mean prompt injection is solved.

原文标题：DeepMind 新论文揭示提示注入仍未解决

Why it matters：该论文用多智能体自动攻击量化了提示注入的真实风险边界，对构建工具调用型 Agent 的开发者具有直接安全警示价值。

Still in preview with sign-up-only access, it is positioned as a team-level product rather than an individual productivity tool, directly contesting recent moves by Fireflies, Wispr Flow, and Granola.

A two-wave December rollout will extend it to Mate 80, Pura 90 and MatePad devices, limited to models with 12GB RAM or more.

The cut continues the restructuring after the xAI-SpaceX merger and signals a strategic pivot toward AI coding tools and the Grok Bot agent, underscored by the $60 billion acquisition of Cursor.

item.title: Rust 编写的独立 XMPP 服务器 Lonewolf 发布 0.3 版
item.description:

item.title: 韩国拟投 36 亿韩元采购设备防范 AI 眼镜作弊
item.description:
韩国国会正审议约 65.7 亿韩元的预算增拨方案，用于采购 7200 台无线电信号探测设备并配备逾 2.3 万名专职监考人员，以应对国家资格考试中利用 AI 眼镜作弊的问题。由于 AI 眼镜外观与普通眼镜高度相似，肉眼识别困难，今年高考仍主要依靠目视检查，韩国教育部已将 AI 眼镜列入考场禁带清单并明确最高 3 年禁考处罚。
